train_train: train the GraphNetwork model on OGB molhiv dataset with configurable batch size and training steps
evaluate_evaluate: evaluate the trained GraphNetwork model on OGB molhiv dataset and return loss and accuracy
build_GraphNetwork: build a flax GraphNetwork module with configurable MLP features and latent size for molecular property prediction
pad_pad_graph_to_nearest_power_of_two: pad a batched GraphsTuple to the nearest power of two to amortize JAX compilation cost
compute_compute_loss: compute cross-entropy loss and accuracy for graph classification with padding mask support
